Usage: sink file [OPTIONS] {put|pull} [SERVER] [FILENAME]

  Send files to and fro.

  Push or pull a single file or directory from a remote server.

  ACTION: pull or put
  SERVER: server name; if omitted the default server is used.
  FILENAME: file/dir to transfer; if omitted the whole project is used.
  With one token, a configured server name selects that server,
  otherwise the token is treated as a filename.

Options:
  -r, --real
  --silent                 Deprecated alias for -qq.
  --extra-flags TEXT       Safe extra flags to pass to rsync; dangerous flags
                           require the override.
  --allow-dangerous-rsync  Allow destructive extra rsync flags.
  --allow-secret-files     Allow secret-looking files in a directory put.
  -h, --help               Show this message and exit.
